page.layout: One page of running text. Printed line numbers (10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) run down the right margin. Running head "TRIUMPHUS" at the top, page number "104" at the top left. Catchword "X. ARITH-" at the lower right.

main_text.p: communis, phantasia, & memoria. Motus est respiratio, pulsus, appetitus sensitiuus (isque partim cupiditas, partim affectus) locomotiua, vigilia, & somnus. In homine est vita intellectiua, eaque tum intellectus agentis & patientis, tum voluntatis, idque vel in hac vita, vel post hanc vitam. Atque hic est locus communis physicus de vita, amplissimus quidem ille & vtilissimus. Huc refer quae passim in Scripturis occurrunt de coloribus, odoribus, calore, frigore, saporibus, fame, siti, visu, auditu, guftu &c.10

XI. Plenitudo mundi est, qua nullum in mundo est vacuum. Mundus enim est corpus continuum & contiguum, spiritu aereo & caelesti, omnia replente & fouente, plenum. Hinc pendet connexio omnium corporum adeo firma & indissolubilis, vt vacuum a nullo15 mortalium vel angelorum in hanc mundanam scenam introduci possit. Confer Hof. 2. v. 21. 22.

XII. Figura mundi est circularis. Haec siquidem figura est pulcherrima & perfectissima, in praecipuis mundi corporibus a Deo expressa. Quod autem ex Apoc.20 21. adfertur de quadratura caelestis Hierosolymae, id est mysticum.

XIII. Duratio mundi est spatium illud temporis inde a primo mundi exordio vsque ad ipsius exitum ac finem. Hoc ex traditione Eliae defi-25nitur (ex[?] millibus annorum. Sed nos infra in Chronologia demonstrauimus ex Dan. 12. & Apoc. 20. longius esse extendendum hoc spatium, vt fiat annorum 6642. Quaeris quomodo fit periturus mundus? Resp. ex 2. Petr. 2. v. 12. 13. coeli conflagrantes soluentur, & elementa aestuantia li-30quescent, igne scil. calcinationis miraculosae, quae longo interuallo superabit calcinationem corporum artificialem, qua illa rediguntur in cinerem, & ex cinere fit corpus glo-35riosum[?].

page.notes: Running head and page number are clear. The margin numbers 10 to 35 are printed line numbers, given here as right-side notes. "(ex" after "defi-" is uncertain, marked [?]. "riosum" at the line end is uncertain (the s may be a long s), marked [?]. "periturus" is read as printed. The catchword "X. ARITH-" is printed at the lower right. The Scripture references are copied as printed, with spacing approximated. The "XI." to "XIII." numerals are italic theses and are kept as paragraphs, not headings.
